mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion can potentiate atomoxetine's sympathomimetic effects and increase cardiovascular risk; atomoxetine may also elevate blood pressure, counteracting torsemide's antihypertensive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum electrolytes regularly; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed; assess for signs of hypokalemia-related arrhythmias or atomoxetine-induced hypertension.
